required_observations.lookback_close: close of last regular-session minute at entry index minus 61
required_observations.previous_close: close of last regular-session minute at entry index minus 1
required_observations.entry_open: open of first regular-session minute at entry index
required_observations.exit_open: open of first regular-session minute five exchange sessions later

quality_contract: Exact required timestamps, unique source rows, finite positive coherent OHLC at required bars; exclude the entire common opportunity if any symbol fails. No interpolation, forward fill, symbol dropping or calendar compression.
price_semantics: Provider all-adjusted bars are research price proxies, not transaction prices. Verify distribution/split treatment before a new evaluation. Do not add cash dividends again to an already dividend-adjusted markout.
corporate_action_review: Freeze provider adjustment documentation and source vintage; reconcile sampled split/distribution events against complete corporate-action metadata. Current split-only data does not satisfy the proposed adjustment contract.
execution_semantics: The previous close is observable before next-session entry. An opening minute price is a historical execution proxy, not guaranteed attainable. Exit then re-entry at a shared boundary is assumed; each completed position pays its full round-trip scenario cost.
allocation: Fixed equal-notional slots, no leverage, shorts, compounding, volatility targeting or overlapping positions within a symbol; inactive slots stay cash. This is not yet a portfolio replay.

costs.rule: Freeze before outcomes; require positive results in the adverse scenarios; never choose a passing cost after seeing results.

untouched_evaluation: A separately approved plan is required; the existing protected holdout cannot be repurposed by this proposal.
